_comment: Global tuning knobs. Stats around 100 are 'average'; damage = power * attack / defense * STAB * type * crit * damage_scale.
_hp_comment: Every species' JSON hp is multiplied by this (fights last longer).
_super_comment: Damage you deal with regular moves that fills the SUPER meter once (a move can override with "charge").

evolution._power_comment: heal_on_evolve = share of max HP healed on evolving or powering up. Pokémon that can't evolve further power up instead (+power_up_bonus HP and attack) up to 3 - stage times.
evolution._comment: Any KOs count toward evolving (they are kept when you faint); evolving resets the count.

candy_rush._comment: Rare Candy Rush (Gem Grab): a candy pops out of the mine every spawn_interval s; a team holding candies_to_win and the lead for countdown s wins.

showdown._comment: Free-for-all, no respawns. The poison cloud starts closing at cloud_start s and reaches a safe_width x safe_depth box at cloud_end s; its damage grows over time. Each power cube adds cube_hp max HP and cube_damage damage.

boss_raid._comment: Boss Raid: 3 vs one giant legendary. boss_hp = times your team's average max HP. Team shares team_lives respawns. strike_damage = share of max HP a telegraphed strike takes. Bosses unlock in order: the first at trainer level first_level, each next one by beating the one before.

gym._comment: Gym rounds: first to kills_to_win KOs (a KO on the leader's ace counts leader_kos). The ace has ace_hp (ace_hp_hard on Hard) times its normal HP.

hazards._comment: Fire vents (F tiles; Fire types immune), warp pads (O tiles) and lightning (map weather; Electric and Ground immune).

hm._comment: HM ability: recharge seconds after each use; Fly distance; Surf swim time; Flash blind and reveal time.

trainer._comment: Profile levels (kept between matches, per evolution line). At the line's evolve_level (Charmander 16, Charmeleon 32) that evolution takes fast_kills KOs in a match instead of kills_to_evolve. Pokémon that power up instead use power_up_levels (first and second Power Up).

legendary._comment: Battle: a raid boss appears when raid_time_left seconds remain; the team that dealt the most damage to it gets it as an ally. King of the Hill: hold the zone alone for shrine_hold seconds straight to awaken the arena's guardian.
